cc:Work.dc:title: Weekly activity includes eight-year and eleven-year boosted models on the same dates.

The final bin is August 31 only. All curves are recorded activity or estimates, not predictions of future fire.
NASA FIRMS-derived local archive; 0.25° grid. VIIRS is an observation reference, not ground-truth fire.
